hypothesis: Geothermal upwelling localises on BLIND structures - faults with little or no surface trace, hence missing from the USGS/INGENIOUS surface-fault catalogues that most GEMSDOE submissions re-dot. Target signature: aeromagnetic horizontal-gradient / RTP-curvature lineations (buried magnetic-basement block boundaries offset by blind faults) gated to the off-catalogue near-field annulus (300 m - 3 km from mapped catalogue traces). Lane K8-1 'blind stepover/relay edge'.
mechanism: Predict fault-conduit probability only in the catalogue near-field annulus: never inside the 300 m catalogue near-field (avoids re-dotting mapped traces = the h19-5/h33 dotted-trace lane), guided by geophysical gradient lineations when the 19-band GeoDAWN stack is available. Values are probabilities in [0, 1]; NaN outside the study footprint. Deterministic synthetic structural template used in verification mode because competition rasters are DrivenData-login-walled (see limitations).
named_non_fault_mimic: Lithologic magnetic contacts / bedrock contacts that are not faults. Mitigation: near-field gate (require proximity to the fault system) plus exclusion of the 300 m catalogue near-field, so the map cannot degenerate into dotted known traces.
difference_from_prior_repo_work: Prior GEMSDOE lanes predict ON or within 300 m of catalogue faults (dotted traces, catalogue tip stepovers) or scatter unguided off-catalogue poisson dots. K8-1 predicts blind-structure probability exclusively in the off-catalogue near-field annulus, guided by geophysical edge lineations.
